flooding has ended on the East Fork White near Rivervale...with
flooding forecast to start at Seymour Friday afternoon.  The
Driftwood River near Edinburgh will be around bankfull Friday
afternoon and evening.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...East Fork White River at Seymour.

* WHEN...From Friday evening to late Monday morning.

* IMPACTS...At 13.5 feet, Lowland flood continues. County Road 700 E
begins to flood.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 10:45 PM EDT Thursday the stage was 9.3 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise above flood stage
tomorrow evening to a crest of 13.4 feet early Saturday
afternoon. It will then fall below flood stage late Sunday
evening.
- Flood stage is 12.0 feet.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Motorists should not attempt to drive around barricades or drive
cars through flooded areas.

Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov/ind.

The next statement should be issued late tonight by around 1245 AM
EDT.
